notes: Calendar: a hand-built '2026 Calendar of Events' page on the new conference website (launched early 2026). It lists 17 items Feb-Dec 2026; 4 holiday/office-closed markers and the first day of school were dropped. No feed, no past calendar: the previous website was a template placeholder in late 2025 and its /events page was taken over by spam in Jan 2026 (Internet Archive), so nothing from the old calendar survives.

Most evidence comes from news: the conference's own 'Ministry Life News' (about 22 posts since Oct 2025) and the Southwestern Union Record (26 Southwest Region stories since mid-Sep 2025). Several are local-church stories; they are kept with level 'church' because they show what happens on the ground.

What the calendar does not show but the news does: evangelism led from the top (president-led Good News Spring Revival at Dallas Project Church, 62 baptisms, ended Apr 25, 2026), youth federations by area (Oklahoma City, Capital Cities), a regional robotics tournament, ACS disaster response after flooding in Avoyelles Parish, LA, and many church community events (backpack giveaways, health fair, rodeo food booth, community breakfasts).
Camp meeting is large: about 3,000 attended at Lone Star Camp (Jun 10-13, 2026) with 19 decisions; summer camp (100+ campers) ended with 18 baptisms.

UNA VOZ 27 (Multicultural Ministries) is a dated evangelism and discipleship plan: official launch Sabbath Oct 10, 2026, monthly emphases through Nov 2027 (prayer Nov 2026, compassion Dec 2026, Bible training Jan 2027, small groups Feb 2027, community service Mar 2027, preparatory series Jun 2027, simultaneous campaigns Sep 2027). Only the launch is counted as an event; the monthly emphases are plans.
Evangelism page publishes a year-to-date baptism report: July 2026 436 vs July 2025 438.
Out of window: Women's Ministries cruise Jul 11-17, 2027 (Symphony of the Seas).
